label: Change Detection (elevation difference raster)
description: The Change Detection comparison, delivered as a GeoTIFF of the elevation difference (after − before, metres, height offset removed) for use in GIS. By default only cells with significant change carry a value. Needs an elevation surface from both surveys. Use the Change Detection plugin for the map layer with cut/fill regions; this one is its numeric companion.

reference_role.title: The comparison survey is the…
reference_role.description: before: the comparison survey is the earlier flight and this survey shows the site afterwards (the usual case when you run this on the newest survey). after: the other way round. Fill means the ground is higher in the later survey, cut means lower.

vertical_alignment.title: Height alignment
vertical_alignment.description: Independent surveys can sit at different heights although the ground never moved. auto: measure that offset on unchanged ground and remove it. tilt: also remove a tilt across the site (surveys without ground control). none: trust both surveys' heights as they are (both tied to ground control points or RTK); the offset is still measured and reported.

horizontal_alignment.title: Horizontal alignment
horizontal_alignment.description: auto: if sliding the comparison survey sideways makes the two surfaces agree clearly better, apply that shift before comparing. off: compare in place.

max_shift_m.title: Largest horizontal shift to search (m)
max_shift_m.description: How far apart the two surveys may sit horizontally. A larger shift is reported but not corrected.

confidence.title: Confidence (%)
confidence.description: How sure a height change must be before it counts, given the noise measured on unchanged ground. 95 is the surveying convention; 80 finds smaller changes and more false ones, 99 fewer of both.

min_height_change_m.title: Smallest height change to count (m)
min_height_change_m.description: 0 = automatic: derived from the measured noise and the confidence, never below 0.05 m. A value raises the bar (it cannot go below what the noise allows).

min_area_m2.title: Smallest region to keep (m²)
min_area_m2.description: Connected patches of change smaller than this are treated as noise and dropped.

registration_tolerance_m.title: Registration tolerance (m)
registration_tolerance_m.description: A cell only counts as changed if it differs from everything within this distance in the other survey, so edges that moved by a pixel are not reported. -1 = one grid cell (wider when a shift was found but not corrected); 0 = off.

edge_buffer_m.title: Edge strip to ignore (m)
edge_buffer_m.description: The outer rim of a reconstruction is unreliable; this much is trimmed from the border of the area both surveys cover.

resolution_m.title: Comparison resolution (m)
resolution_m.description: 0 = the coarser of the two surveys' own resolutions, coarsened automatically if the site is too large for the sandbox. Cells are averaged, so volumes do not depend on it.

vegetation_filter.title: Keep vegetation out of cut and fill
vegetation_filter.description: Uses the orthophotos to find green vegetation; height change there is reported as its own class and not counted as earthwork. Needs at least one orthophoto.

mask_insignificant.title: Only cells with significant change
mask_insignificant.description: On: cells without significant change are empty (transparent on the map). Off: the full difference over the area both surveys cover.
